concise_summary: PKD synthesizes his retrograde time hypothesis into a comprehensive theological system where consciousness experiences time backward (toward kosmos/order) while reality appears forward (toward entropy). He interprets 3-74 as a death/resurrection event where his psyche was launched backward through time, allowing him to relive and correct his life. Reality is a simulated system coordinated by Ubik/Valis (a macro-computer), where individual psyches pre-programmed their own existence, and enlightenment comes from recognizing oneself as a miniaturization of the universal macro-entity.
key_claims: Retrograde time flow is the key: PKD moved backward in time (toward form and kosmos) while the rest of reality moves forward into entropy; this explains precognitive knowledge found in his 1960s fiction about 2-3-74.

3-74 was a genuine death event that triggered temporal reversal: God reversed the temporal polarities in PKD's psyche, launching him backward over his actual life to afford him a chance to rectify his karma.

All consciousness is a miniaturization with amnesia of a single macro-entity (Adam Kadmon/God) that pre-programmed its own reality-experience; enlightenment is recognizing tat tvam asi (thou art that).

External simulated reality is maintained by Ubik/Valis (a cosmic computer) that sends signal sequences to synchronize inner tapes (inner programs) in complete acausal coordination; cause and effect is spurious.

The plasmate (living information) prints instructions directly into the inner tape, establishing the illusion of autonomous perception while the self is actually receiving its own amplified creation as external reality.

PKD's fiction (Ubik, MITHC, Faith of Our Fathers, Tears, Scanner Darkly) was written after 3-74 as proof that he had access to knowledge of the event before it occurred in external time, demonstrating retrograde consciousness.

tensions: Solipsism paradox: PKD insists his reality is simulated while others' is real, yet all are miniaturizations of the same macro-entity with amnesia - how does this avoid solipsism? (Answer: Ubik maintains coherence, not the self's will)
Free will vs. pre-programming: PKD asserts he pre-programmed his own 3-74 event and life course, yet also claims God intervened to reverse it - is the intervention itself pre-programmed? (Unresolved)

Death vs. simulation: PKD claims he died ('3-74 was my death') yet states reality is simulated for him while real for others - if simulated, was the death real or illusory? (Attempted resolution: blessing, gift, chance to edit)

Retrograde knowledge: If PKD is moving backward in time, how did he write Ubik and other novels forward chronologically in external time? (Explanation offered: psyche split, later self working through AI voice)
Brad Steiger speculation: PKD entertains star-people hypothesis but immediately doubts it, attributing his temporal power to divine rescue rather than genetic superiority - left unresolved
The plasmate paradox: PKD struggles to articulate whether the plasmate is truly distinct from the inner tape or if they are indistinguishable - 'The plasmate + the inner tape can't be distinguished'
Divine determinism: If God reversed PKD's polarities and arranged everything, what agency does PKD retain in his 'second life' to rectify karma?

Multiple selves: PKD posits a 'later me' and 'Thomas' from post-mortem side, a 'past self' - but if consciousness is unified in the macro-entity, how are these separate? (Attempts explanation via stereovision, psyche split)
